title: Morning, the mug
logline: A week before the last page: the chipped white enamel mug on the dock's plank, steaming, nobody's hand on it yet. The dock, the water, the chimney across the bay smoking. Chloe's mug, before Chloe.

panels.composition: The dock at sunrise, close on a chipped white enamel mug set on the planks, steaming, and beyond it the bay and the cannery chimney across the water with a thread of smoke. No hand on the mug. The plank's grain. The light coming.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a chipped white enamel mug steaming on a dock's planks at sunrise with a bay beyond and a distant chimney with a thread of smoke, no hand on the mug, no people, no words
image.notes: The final page's mug and chimney, a week early, without her.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The mug before the hand. The chimney smoking.
